फक्क्: फक्क् फक्क्, i. 1, Par.  1. † To creep, to move slowly.  2. † To act wrongly.
फक्किका: फक्किका फक्किका, f.  1. An asser-tion to be proved.  2. A sophism.  3. Fraud.
फट्: फट् फट्, A mystical syllable, Bhāg. P. 6, 8, 8.
फट: फट फट (probably स्फट् + अ),  I. m., and f. टा, The expanded hood or neck of the cobra di capello, or snake, Pañc. iii. d. 83; i. d. 229.  II. f. टा।  1. A tooth.  2. A cheat.
फण्: फण् फण्, i. 1, Par. To go. Caus. फणय,  1. To cause to go.  2. To produce easily (cf. फाण्ट).
फण: फण फण, m., and f. णा, The expanded hood or neck of the cobra di capello, or snake in general, Pañc. i. d. 107; Śāk. d. 158; Bhartṛ. 2, 28 (णा).  -- Comp. अवाक्फ्°, i. e. अवाञ्च्-, adj. with downcast neck, Ṛt. 1, 13 v. r. गो-फणा, f. a concave bandage for the chin, nose, etc., Suśr. 1, 65, 18.
फणभृत्: फणभृत् फण-भृ + त्, फणवन्त् फण + वन्त्, and फणिन् फणिन्, i. e. फण + इन्, m. A snake, Kir. 5, 11 (°भृत्); 27 (वन्त्); Pañc. i. d. 175 (°णिन्).
फर्फरीक: फर्फरीक फर्फरीक,  I. m. The palm of the hand with the fingers ex-tended.  II. n.  1. Sweetness.  2. A shoot.
फल्: फल् फल् (sprung from original स्पर्, cf. स्फर्, स्फुर्), i. 1, Par.  1. To burst, MBh. 3, 1654.  2. To disappear (as if by bursting), MBh. 13, 7472.  3. To produce, Hit. ii. d. 132.  4. To bear fruit, figuratively, Man. 1, 84; to fall to one's share, Hit. 54, 18; to be-fall, Hit. iii. d. 21 (साधुषु, the good ones).  5. To be fruitful, Bhartṛ. 2, 38.  6. To be useful, 2, 98.  7. Im-personal pass. फलितम् (supply अस्ति), Fruit is borne, produced, Hit. 21, 13.  8. † To go. Ptcple. of the pf. pass.  I. फलित (or फल + इत),  1. Fruitful, bearing fruit, Hit. 47, 3, M.M.  2. Suc-cessful, Daśak. in Chr. 196, 1.  II. फुल्ल (instead of फल् + न),  1. Blown, expanded as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 6; Pañc. i. d. 152.  2. Opened (as the eyes, with pleasure), smiling. -- With the prep. उद् उद्, उत्फुल्ल,  1. Blown, as a flower, Kir. 5, 39.  2. Expanded (as the eyes, with fear), Rām. 3, 50, 15; (with surprise, with joy), Hit. 51, 10, M.M.; Indr. 2, 26. Caus. फालय, To open, MBh. 1, 5977. -- With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, प्रोत्फुल्ल, Blown, as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 34. -- With प्र प्र, प्रफुल्ल,  1. Blown, as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 1.  2. Smiling.  3. Shining.  4. Glad. -- With प्रति प्रति, To bound against, to be reflected, Śiś. 9, 37. प्रतिफलित,  1. Reflected.  2. Requited. -- Cf. probably ὄϕελος, ὀϕέλλω; Lat. flos; A.S. blowan; Goth. bloma; A.S. bloma, blostma.
फल: फल फल् + अ, n.  1. Fruit, Utt. Rāmac. 33, 8.  2. Revenue, Hit. iv. d. 121.  3. Consequence, Chr. 9, 43.  4. Result, Hit. iv. d. 98 (संख्या-मा-त्रम्, consisting only in the number, i. e. by reckoning four you have nothing but the number, really there is only one).  5. Fulfilment of an omen, Śāk. d. 15.  6. Gain, Bhartṛ. 2, 18.  7. Reward.  8. A shield.  9. The blade of a sword or knife, the head of an arrow, Daśak. 197, 2(?).  10. A ploughshare.  -- Comp. अ-, adj., f. ला। 1. Without fruit, Rām. 4, 59, 12. 2. unproductive, Man. 2, 158; figurat. 234. 3. unprofitable, prejudicial, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 8. कर्म(न्)-, n. retribution for actions, Man. 11, 231. कृष्ट-, n. the value of the crop, Yājñ. 2, 158. क्षीण-, (vb. क्षि), adj. fruitless, Pañc. ii. d. 102. त्रि-,  I. adj., f. ला, endowed with three fruits, Kām. Nītis. 8, 42.  II. f. ला, the three myrobalans. निष्फ्°, i. e. निस्-, adj., f. ला। 1. without fruit, Rām. 4, 48, 6. 2. fruitless, useless, Man. 3, 144. 3. unproductive, Pañc. 174, 19. 4. irrelevant. पुण्य-, n. re-ward of virtue or meritorious works Man. 3, 95. पुरःफ्°, i. e. पुरस्-, adj. of which the fruit is coming on. मरुत्-, n. hail. महा-,  I. n. a great fruit, Bhartṛ. 2, 86.  II. m. a fruit-tree, Aegle marmelos.  III. f. ला, a bitter gourd. मन्द-, adj., f. ला, bearing scanty fruit, Lass. 35, 20. मुक्ता-, n. 1. a pearl, Pañc. pr. d. 9. 2. camphor. यथा-फल + म्, when bearing fruit, Pañc. i. d. 246. वि-, adj. vain, fruit-less useless Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1395. शारि-, n. a chequered cloth or fable for playing draughts. श्री-, 1. m. a fruit-tree, Aegle marmelos. 2. (n.) the fruit of the Vilva, Man. 5, 120. स-, adj. 1. bearing fruit, Hit. i. d. 10, M.M.; rewarded, Vikr. 10, 9; ful-filled, Vikr. d. 27. 2. yielding a profit. 3. blessed, Rājat. 5, 373. सु-,  I. adj. bearing good fruit.  II. m., and f. ला, the name of several plants.
फलक: फलक फल + क,  I. (m. and) n.  1. A board, Man. 8, 396.  2. A bench, Man. 2, 204 (Kull.).  3. A layer, a base, Megh. 77 (at the end of a comp. adj., f. का, Having a base of crystal).  4. Surface, Bhartṛ. 2, 28.  5. A shield.  6. A leaf for writing on, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 13 (? a small table).  7. The bone of the forehead.  II. n.  1. The buttocks.  2. The receptacle of the seed = core; in गण्ड-, a core-like, or core-representing cheek, Śiś. 9, 47 (at the end of a comp. adj. Having cheeks instead of cores).  -- Comp. चि-त्र-, n. a table with a likeness, a pic-ture, Śāk. 85, 17. शिला-, n. a layer or table of stone.
फलपाकान्त: फलपाकान्त फलपाकान्त, i. e. फ-ल-पाक + अन्त,  I. adj., f. ता, Perishing when the fruit is mature, Man. 1, 46.  II. f. ता, An annual plant.
फलमुद्गरिका: फलमुद्गरिका फलमुद्गरिका, i. e. फल-मुद्गर + क, f. A sort of date.
फलवत्: फलवन्त् फल + वन्त्, adj. वति, Bearing fruit, Man. 1, 47; fruitful, Hit. pr. 43, M.M.
फलवन्त्: फलवन्त् फल + वन्त्, adj. वति, Bearing fruit, Man. 1, 47; fruitful, Hit. pr. 43, M.M.
फलस: फलस फल-स, m. The jack or bread-fruit-tree
फलिन्: फलिन् फलिन्, i. e. फल + इन्,  I. adj., f. नी, Having fruits, Cāṇ. 21 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 408; bearing fruit, Man. 1, 47.  II. m. A tree, MBh. 14, 498.  III. f. नी।  1. = Pri-yaṅgu.  2. A potherb, Echites dicho-toma.  3. A flower, Celosia cristata.
फलिन: फलिन फलिन् + अ, adj. Bearing fruit.
फल्क: फल्क फल्क, adj., explained by विशोधिताङ्क, which may be विशोधित -अङ्क, or शोधित-अङ्क with वि। -- Cf. perhaps ϕολκός.
फल्गु: फल्गु फल्गु, i. e. स्फुर्ज् + अ,  I. adj.  1. Pithless, sapless.  2. Vain, worth-less, Pañc. pr. d. 10.  3. Weak, Hit. iii. d. 79.  II. f.  1. The opposite-leaved fig-tree.  2. The spring season.  3. Falsehood.
फल्गुता: फल्गुता फल्गु + ता, f., and फल्गुत्व फल्गु + त्व, n. Vainness, Bhartṛ. 2, 9.  -- Cf. सारफल्गुत्व।
फल्गुन: फल्गुन फल्गु + न,  I. m.  1. The month Phālguna.  2. A name of Arjuna.  II. f. नी, du. or pl. The eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished as former, पूर्व, and latter, उत्तर; see फाल्गुन।
फल्गुनक: फल्गुनक फल्गुन + क, m.  1. Name of a people, Mārk. P. 58, 36.  2. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 472.
फल्य: फल्य फल्य, i. e. फल + य, n. A flower.
फाण्ट: फाण्ट फाण्ट, i. e. फण्, Caus., + त,  I. ptcple. of the pf. pass. of the causal of फण्, Readily or easily prepared.  II. m. Diluted decoction  III. n. The first particle of butter that are pre-pared by churning.
फाण्ड: फाण्ड फाण्ड (cf. फण्ड), n. The belly.
फाल: फाल फाल, i. e. फल् + अ,  I. m. n. The share of a plough, Man. 4, 46; 6, 16.  II. m. A name of Śiva and Balarāma.
फाल्गुन: फाल्गुन फाल्गुन, i. e. फल्गुन + अ,  I. m.  1. A month, February -- March, Rājat. 5, 221.  2. A name of Arjuna, Johns. Sel. 13, 43.  3. A sort of tree, Pentaptera arjuna.  II. f. नी।  1. The day of full moon in the month Phāl-guna.  2. The name of the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distin-guished by the epithet former, पूर्व, and latter, उत्तर।
फुट: फुट फुट, probably स्फुट् + अ, m., f. टा, and n. The expanded hood or neck of a snake, Pañc. 174, 11 (त).
फुत्: फुत् फुत्, indecl.  1. The expression of disregard.  2. Imitative sound, im-plying the boiling of water, etc. (see कृ, and cf. फूत्).
फुत्कार: फुत्कार फुत्-कार,  I. adj. Disdain-ful, arrogant.  II. m. The sound of bubbling (see फूत्कार).
फुल्ल्: † फुल्ल् फुल्ल् (cf. फल्), i. 1, Par. To blossom.
फूत्: फूत् फूत् = फुत्,  1. Imitative sound of blowing, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1184.  2. Crying aloud, expression of indignation, anger, Pañc. 35, 11; 82, 18; 193, 11; Vetālap. xviii. MS. (see कृ).
फूत्कर्तुमनस्: फूत्कर्तुमनस् फूत्कर्तुमनस्, i. e. फूत्-कर्तुम्-मनस्, adj. Intending to cry aloud, to rage, Pañc. 40, 19.
फूत्कार: फूत्कार फूत्-कार, m.  1. Blowing, hissing, Kathās. 22, 183.  2. Crying aloud, 13, 59.
फेन: फेन फेन, probably akin to स्फाय्, m.  1. Froth, foam, Vikr. d. 115.  2. Moisture, Man. 3, 19.  3. Vapour.  4. Cuttle-fish bone.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. not frothy, Man. 2, 61. -- Cf. A.S. fam, foeman; Lat. spuma.
फेनल: फेनल फेन + ल, फेनवन्त् फेन + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Frothy, foamy, Arj. 6, 2 (वन्त्).
फेनाय: फेनाय फेनाय, a denomin. derived from फेन with य (Par.), Ātm. To froth, to foam, MBh. 6, 101.
फेनिन्: फेनिन् फेनिन्, i. e. फेन + इन्, फेनिल फेनिल, i. e. फेन + इल, adj. Frothy, foamy, Hiḍ. 2, 11 (निन्); Ragh. 13, 2 (निल).
फेर: फेर फेर, and फेरु फेरु, m. A jackal.
फेरव: फेरव फेरव, i. e. फेरु + अ,  I. adj.  1. Fraudulent.  2. Malicious.  II. m.  1. A jackal, Mālat. 79, 17.  2. A Rāk-ṣasa, Kathās. 47, 53.
फेल्: † फेल् फेल्, i. 1, Par. To go.
फेल: फेल फेल, n., फेला फेला, f., फेलि and फेली फेली̆, फेलिका फेलि + का, f. Orts, leavings of a meal, or droppings from the mouth.
